status: Source candidate only. No compilation, checker, component, Root17 or business qualification was executed by this author.
scope: Explicit Linux/Android ordinary daemon mode, selected at flag positions in the original flag/value argv grammar.
Original signed Control ObjectiveStart is the only A/C task admission. Its original acknowledgement is not an Outcome.
Actual prepared A, original retained source, real Cell/Product evaluation, original Artifact/Selection/CURRENT and same-actor C owners remain the authority path.
This packet does not implement independent cross-principal C, cold-restart qualification or a normal completion/Root-exit success proof.

invocation.original_inputs: The existing Starting identity, original Primary/Android inputs, original three-right Root writer handoff and original parser-owned inherited descriptors are still mandatory. All 15 original FD fields are included in the pre-ownership alias check. Do not substitute descriptor integers for transferred capabilities.
invocation.default: Without the selector at a flag position the existing production parser, default startup and Launch.run remain the selected path. Program name has already been removed by main; the original parser accepts flag/value pairs, not a new positional/-- grammar.
invocation.selected_first_action: OriginalPhaseReceiveStart::capture() occurs before parsing selected-mode flags or taking FDs. Original launcher Instant, sealed Root BOOTTIME and session limits can only shorten the existing bounds.
invocation.supported_primary: This phase-only run uses the actual Android MCP/Device composition. It does not introduce Notes UI or a synthetic device.
invocation.completion: Current normal completion remains explicitly unavailable. The actual A/C accepted outcome path retains the same peer/owners until common closure and returns an error.

file_contracts.format: Canonical serde JSON and explicit SHA256 pin where defined by PinnedFileData.
file_contracts.requirements: Actual Root UID 0, daemon primary GID, mode 0640, immediate Root-owned same-GID directory mode 0750 or 02750. Absolute canonical parent; O_NOFOLLOW/O_CLOEXEC/O_NONBLOCK; regular single-link file; full physical and parent pins before/after parsing.
file_contracts.missing: Original I/O error or explicit deployment refusal. No default descriptor, key, role or trust record is generated.

file_contracts.kind: Immutable ordinary data and external response
file_contracts.format: Exact UTF8 serde_json::to_vec representation, with complete fields; parsing roundtrip must equal original bytes. No trailing newline/alternate whitespace is accepted by this specific canonical reader.
file_contracts.requirements: Root or actual daemon UID, single link, no group/other write bits, bounded nonempty regular file; expected SHA256 for pinned inputs; retained FD and parent physical identity. Same immutable inode can recur only with the same exact data pin; mutable source/sink aliases are refused.
file_contracts.missing: Only a not-yet-visible external response can be waited for within its original operation budget. Once visible, malformed/partial/unauthorized/changed data is a terminal error; it is not reread or repaired.

file_contracts.format: The original owner codec, not JSON reconstructed receipts.
file_contracts.requirements: Explicit CreateNew, ExistingEmpty or Recover; actual daemon UID, mode 0600, single link, private actual-UID parent with no group/other permissions. CreateNew uses create_new and parent fsync; ExistingEmpty must be empty; Recover must be nonempty. Distinct device/inode ownership across actual sources/witnesses/execution/evidence.
file_contracts.missing: No existing-to-genesis fallback, empty recovery, implicit path creation or replacement owner.

file_contracts.requirements: Pinned actual daemon UID 0600 file and exact enrolled verifying key. The Root-approved trust is activated through the existing authenticated trust API.
file_contracts.missing: No generated private key, role, enrollment or signature.

file_contracts.format: The original Root deployment reader's exact profile and canonical Current material.
file_contracts.requirements: Remain Root 0600 under the original Root-private directory/pin contract. The daemon's peer data and data-ready notice are not a Root write capability or authorization.
file_contracts.missing: A real trusted Root-side supplier must publish the approved material. This daemon packet does not provide that supplier or automatically approve its own profile/material.

stages.actual_owners: Original Root writer/session, actual Primary/device, original plasticity full owner loader, actual Artifact owner and Initial journal/model, actual Circuit task source and fresh authenticated A ledger.
stages.refusal: Missing/mismatched binding, unsafe FD alias/permissions/file identity, missing actual registered owner or invalid original trust refuses before readiness.

required_fields: objective_a: exact signed AuthBusObjectiveIngress with actual distinct run
completion_a: schema_version, exact phase, actual signed Outcome, original preparation request/budget/owners
stages.actual_owners: Original Control ObjectiveStart once, original Agentd actual Running/readiness, original task ledger producer and actual durable task completion validation.
stages.refusal: ACK loss or Conflict is terminal; no resubmit. Control Admitted is retained only as control evidence. The supplied Outcome must pass the existing independent observer/task/receipt checks; no Outcome is synthesized.

required_fields: actual Prepared Arc from original producer
actual root_profile computed by that Prepared and original writer proof
one external material-ready response with exact request and material digest
stages.actual_owners: Same Prepared/scope/identity, actual A journal/source/retirement, original Root join and durable once-claim. Root independently reads its approved profile.
stages.refusal: Data-ready is only a delivery signal. It precedes begin_original_retirement and the Root frame request_started capture. Missing approval, ACK loss, closed Gate or any expired original bound remains a failure.

stages.stage: Independent B inputs after actual Training
required_fields: actual candidate and fixed-expert nonempty experiment journals and witnesses
stages.actual_owners: Original Cell frozen plan derives from actual journals/plans and the pre-training evaluation-profile pin in the same Prepared request. The original Cell/Product runner actually consumes the final holdout and evaluates, persists signed execution, and qualifies into the real evidence sink.
stages.refusal: No canned evaluation/qualification receipt, fabricated rows/costs/role, or digest-only sink. Original matched-budget, role independence, plan/fold/holdout, evidence and cost checks remain mandatory. SystemLongitudinal material is explicitly refused because this adapter has no actual timing-owner handoff for it.

required_fields: registered evaluator/generator identity and independently produced signatures
stages.actual_owners: Original synchronous attestor request after the existing execution claim/consume; original Product verifier reauthenticates signature, role, principal, objective, payload and clock before commit/readback.
stages.refusal: The single operation can wait under its original business/Gate expiry for the actor's first atomic response. Existing Pending is not rerun, late/invalid response is not retried, and the request is never regenerated with a new nonce or deadline.

required_fields: actual Artifact owner CURRENT floor/trust/writer lease
independently signed Selection and original selector trust
stages.actual_owners: Existing Artifact owner lock and original apply/readback methods; original independent Selection verification. No local auto-selection/signature generation is added.
stages.refusal: Pending Artifact repair, missing current floor, bad trusted minimum, mismatched actual selection digest, wrong signer or stale/fenced original owner are terminal.

required_fields: actual original C observer/target/config and fresh C journal/witness
stages.actual_owners: Original target file identities, same actual A predecessor file origin and retained model, original Root approved Current read view and publication capability, original same-actor successor route/slot/task source.
stages.refusal: C must keep original same-actor identity constraints and a distinct actual run/input. No independent-node claim, reopening/rearm of failed C, or default C Outcome is made.

timing_and_custody: Prepared-material-ready wait is before begin_original_retirement; unchanged Root request_started still begins only when that actual original request starts.
Root framed operations keep the unchanged 500 ms accounting and original absolute end. Waiting outside a request does not refresh the session.

External actor waits use the actual same Prepared envelope expiry or original A/C claim deadline and same Gate; BOOTTIME/Instant clock guards remain the original ones. NotFound is a pre-response wait, not retry of an issued authority operation.

The selected owner std thread and concrete coordinator std thread retain real JoinHandles. Cancellation closes common Gate/required stream aliases before joining; the original multi-thread Tokio runtime stays alive to drive real joins.

The two bootstrap consumer spawn_blocking handles, Circuit outer handle and Session worker/consumer handles are held in the aeb5/173ee/0fceb dependency caps. Empty counters/notifications do not certify physical join.
Current packet is fault cleanup only. No seq1/seq2 retirement token, normal Session release or RootExited proof is minted from data/EOF/third ACK.
external_suppliers_not_implemented: Trusted deployment/Root approval material producer and inherited actual rights provider.
Real ordinary application issuing the two signed ObjectiveStart requests and independent observer producing actual A/C Outcomes.
Independent real experiment/holdout data and measured cost provider.
Registered external evaluator/generator signing actors that validate their original requested operation before signing.
Independent Artifact/Selection authority and the actual C target preparation material.
Full normal C/Learning/Session/Root retirement, Root pidfd exit chain and an external parent observing the daemon's own OS exit.
